P01.name: Access and onboarding

P02.name: Home and personal profile

P03.name: Find care and booking

P04.name: Patient messages and consultations

P05.name: Records, labs, and reports

P06.name: Medications and prescriptions

P07.name: Lifestyle

P08.name: Connected devices
P08.finish: Complete selection, consent, connection, sync progress/success/failure, disconnect, and actual supported-device ingestion.

P09.name: AI, discovery, and community

P10.name: Pharmacy discovery and orders

P11.name: Settings, support, and billing
P11.finish: Complete account/security/support first, persistent notification preferences with follow-up work, and billing with the commerce contract.

S01.name: Professional onboarding and identity
S01.finish: Implement partner selection, credentials, applications/status, professional editing, and the approved specialist entry flow.

S02.name: Doctor, nurse, and specialist dashboards

S03.name: Availability, schedules, and requests
S03.finish: Implement availability editing, working hours, schedule views, consultation request decisions, and conflict handling.

S04.name: Patient roster and clinical records

S05.name: Consultation workspace and team chat

S06.name: Prescription issuing

S07.name: Publishing and community management

S08.name: Hospital and pharmacy partner operations
